row.answer: Mel is a mage/support with AP-scaling magic damage. She builds Overwhelm through repeated hits and can strike marked enemies regardless of distance with her ultimate. Her barrier can reflect enemy champion projectiles.
row.counterplay: Avoid prolonged trades and hold key projectiles while her barrier is active.
